notes: Normalize by choosing y even. Establish pairwise coprimality and parity. Factor x^2=(z-y)(z+y); the two positive odd factors are coprime, hence squares b^2 and a^2. Put m=(a+b)/2, n=(a-b)/2. Verify formulas, gcd(m,n)=1, and opposite parity. Converse: identity plus prime-divisor argument for primitivity. Complete theorem accepted as fact a932ff05f46ca574.
